g.title: EleanorRank6Convo7 begins.
g.text: EleanorRank6Convo7 begins.

g.title: j3243201321
g.text: Tell me something if you would.

g.title: j1357088153
g.text: My brother.

g.title: j2722978933
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j2649835381
g.text: You and he are a Thing and I am very happy about that

g.title: j2722978933->j2649835381
g.text: true

g.title: j1847478205
g.text: You know him pretty well by now, after everything we've endured together, as a group

g.title: j2722978933->j1847478205
g.text: false

g.title: j3013339699
g.text: I just need to know:

g.title: j2104753873
g.text: how do you cope when he does The Voice?

g.title: j115767462
g.text: It doesn't really affect me.

g.title: j1633637050
g.text: I LOVE it.

g.title: j3797870698
g.text: I like it.

g.title: j1769028172
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j1478389164
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3875211189
g.text: okay. well

g.title: j2552081671
g.text: I mean, it's not BAD

g.title: j4130480187
g.text: I feel like you MUST know what I mean, but I shall take your answer in good faith.

g.title: j305452677
g.text: Wonderful. A clear case of naturally occurring immunity!

g.title: j877091906
g.text: you're certainly not alone in that, from what I gather

g.title: j912692574
g.text: I can't really take it seriously though. There are reasons.

g.title: j3581595185
g.text: Most of the time Arthur talks like a fairly normal human being, but there are times when he does The Voice.

g.title: j637530466
g.text: We must ensure your body is donated to medical science.

g.title: j1461083585
g.text: ... I just need you to know that to me, that will always be his Action Angus voice.

g.title: j3688390263
g.text: It's like listening to someone fix you a testosterone milkshake stirred up in a cement mixer.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j78355801
g.text: "STAY CALM AND LET THE PROFESSIONALS HANDLE THIS" growls 8 year old Arthur as Action Angus and the plastic SAS are rescuing one of my Sandie dolls from the dinosaur army

g.title: j3746706031
g.text: It's so gravelly you could pick neolithic axe heads out of it.

g.title: j2534128252
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3214206825
g.text: For some reason it leaves otherwise sane and well adjusted people weak at the knees.

g.title: j1833756739
g.text: Hope I haven't ruined it for you!

g.title: j1612902731
g.text: Do you understand what I mean now?

g.title: j2230223121
g.text: Oh, right. The Voice.

g.title: j3761809276
g.text: Um... no. [End.]
